answer: Register one released falcon per applicant. A warden bands the bird with a numbered ferrous ring and sets a pearl bead in the marker stone at the cliff. Each season the falcon returns to that cliff, and the applicant photographs the band twice a year for the warden to match. A missing bird voids the identity for 180 days and burns a 150 token bond. Raising 10,000 fake falcons costs 1,800,000 dollars and 10,000 field seasons, and freezes 1,500,000 tokens. A falcon that comes home is a receipt no printer can copy, and a forged flock starves in the first winter because no bird returns.
